immutable_validation.method: Reconstruct every pre-annotation row from the task/output manifests, remove only fields written by annotate_ui.py, then compare per-task hashes.

validator_correction: The frozen preparer mistakenly included annotation.needs_human_review in its immutable hash even though annotate_ui.py changes it on every completed primary annotation. The analysis rule, selection, packet, task/output inputs, and labels were not changed. The corrected validation reconstructs the original rows and excludes only the UI-owned fields listed above.
